properties.title: BIS rule (2026-11-19): Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors
properties.summary: Action: Interim final rule. In this interim final rule (IFR), the Department of Commerce is establishing new rules to prevent certain foreign actors from leveraging advanced computing power based on U.S. technology to threaten U.S. national security and foreign policy interests. First, this rule establishes new restrictions which will apply for exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) to overseas data centers that remotely supply significant volumes of compute to companies headquartered in Country Group D:5 or... Effective 2026-11-19. Federal Register document 2026-23529.
